title: Dirab xongolo
intro: ramad fantaaxaw aysinu ossotina gabbatak suge. sirri ekraaro urteh sugte, tekkookah angoyyih silsilatal liggidittet taturtam kee baar le baxxo tabaanam. Ta buttah abtoota kaxxa baxsi kee rooka katasse, takkay immay aydaadi wokkel gaba makalo. Tah aylahsoonuuy, nadaamaa kee qibaadah ekraaroh ellecabo maybalaalaqah aydaadu. atu too cankâ marih kinnaane baxxaqissam duuddaa ken doorit horah horal qagte?
clues: Nanu ninnik numuh yunbulle kacanul aysinat nakme.
ni aysinu, nanu sittalih celsisneeh ninni tooboko qeeli diteh addat qidne.
ni abto qellisnuh, dirab qabalat radde sartan ni abbah xayyosne.
Liggiditteek lakal, kaxxa qulul nee dirkiseh Masri fan genxuh maaqo gorrisnuh.
wokkel, nanu caylale doolatak foocal nemeete, nee amixxige wayta, nanu qellat abneh nan toobokok sugte.
Nek ellecaboh aqayyaare nek qunxa toobokoyta Binyamin, nek taturteh tan uddur kee ni abba Nabiyyi Ya'qub kinnim tamixxige.

outcome.label: Ni aydaaduk ellecabo xaloot macak sugteeh?
options: Nanu cabsu neh yekkeeh, ninni buxah marat nangoorowe
outcome.answer: Nanu cabsu neh yekkeeh, ninni buxah marat nangoorowe

arabic: قَالُوا۟ تَٱللَّهِ لَقَدْ ءَاثَرَكَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا وَإِن كُنَّا لَخَـٰطِـِٔينَ
verse: They said, "By Allāh, certainly has Allāh preferred you over us, and indeed, we have been sinners." (12:91)
